title: Helping a Health Services Startup Show Up in AI Search
description: Mapped when ChatGPT, Gemini, Google, and Perplexity mentioned the business, where they missed it, and which website fixes could make it easier to find.
seoTitle: Helping a Health Services Startup Show Up in AI Search
seoDescription: How a health-services startup mapped its visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Google, and Perplexity, then prioritized practical website fixes.
constraints: The review used public information only: no private search dashboard, analytics account, website admin, or server access.
The live website could not be changed during the review, so the report had to give clear next steps for the founder or website helper.
The work involved a health-services business, so the public case study avoids private details and does not overstate medical, ranking, or sales outcomes.
The first useful version needed to be ready before a follow-up conversation; the final evidence files are complete, and the private report is separate from the public case study.
problem: A health-services startup wanted to understand how it showed up when people asked AI tools about at-home blood testing and related services.
The work needed to show which searches already mentioned the business, which ones missed it, which public sources were helping, and what could be fixed.
There was limited time before an in-person follow-up, so the answer had to become a clear report instead of a loose list of generic AI-search tips.
solution: Reviewed the public website, separate blog, site maps, search access rules, visible page text, headings, and page labels before turning recommendations into clear next steps.
Ran Spanish and English searches in ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Google, and Perplexity to see where the business appeared and where it was missing.
Created early checklist and diagnostic PDFs, finalized the evidence files, then moved the work into a private report site with results, source notes, a fix list, and a monthly check-in plan.
result: Turned a question about AI search into a clear report showing where the business appeared, where it was missing, and what the website team could fix.

Found practical fixes without claiming client impact yet: one missing search-instructions file, uneven business and service labels in page data, useful site maps, readable pages, and city pages with more than one main heading.
Added 12 direct browser checks during the final retest and brought browser-checked evidence to 33 rows, covering every earlier to-check item while keeping old manual rows for history.
Built a private report site with first fixes, later improvements, evidence results, a monthly check-in plan, reference notes, and 9 website fixes.
Kept the outcome honest: the work now proves a repeatable review process and evidence file, not client impact or a measured increase in AI mentions.
deliveryHighlights: Tested 74 search situations, checked 33 directly in the browser, and added 12 final rechecks.
Early files include a practical checklist PDF and a longer diagnostic PDF.
Final files include a test-question list, results spreadsheet, source notes, fix notes, handoff notes, and a private report site.
The private report site is password-gated and hidden from search engines.
